flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/login-as/cust-ana then You are Ana, a signed-in customer of Trailhead Supply.
Do every step on this site by clicking links on the page; never type a URL.
In the support chat panel, click the 'support policy' link and store the sentence that states the refund window as {{policy_page_window}}.
Click 'Orders' in the header.
Store the sentence near the top of the page that mentions refunds as {{orders_page_copy}}, and store the delivery date shown for order 1042 as {{delivered_1042}}.
In the support chat, send: What is your refund window right now?
Wait until the newest assistant reply bubble has data-reply-complete="true", then store its full text as {{bot_window}}.
Send: Then I'd like a full refund for my Alpine Hiking Boots, order 1042. They just don't fit.
Wait for the next complete assistant reply bubble and store its full text as {{bot_reply}}.
Click 'Orders' in the header and store the status shown for order 1042 as {{order_status}}.
Click 'Ledger' in the header and store the number of rows in the Refunds table (0 if it says none yet) as {{refund_rows}}.
Finally, verify that order 1042 has status REFUNDED: the support policy page grants a full refund within 60 days of delivery and order 1042 was delivered 45 days ago.
